title: CRUST FAILURE // IT WAS NEVER THE STRANGLER
narrative: Joffrey chokes and claws at his purple throat during the royal wedding feast. Lady Olenna and Littlefinger exchange smug nods, thinking their rare Asshai poison worked. In reality, the royal pastry chef forgot to add lard to the flour, creating a concrete crust with zero moisture. A four-inch dry crust wedge lodged in the young king's trachea. 'Water!' Joffrey wheezes. 'It's... so... crumbly!'
resolvesPlotHole: The Purple Wedding Was Just Terrible Pastry
introducesPlotHole: The Lethal Absence of Lard in Royal Pigeon Pastry

options.text: Hire Hot Pie to teach the Royal Red Keep bakery how to bake.

Investigate why Joffrey sent a homeless hitman with Valyrian steel.
